item.title: Venezuela quake deaths rise to 1,943, lawmaker says
item.description: Venezuela's earthquake death toll reached 1,943, a lawmaker reported. item.description: Japanese opposition lawmaker Chikage Koga stated on June 15 that economically disadvantaged children enlist in the Self-Defense Forces.
